usage: trustweave ci [-h] [--config CONFIG] [--no-config-discovery] [--output-dir OUTPUT_DIR]
                     [--source-revision SOURCE_REVISION] [--coverage] [--exit-on-review]
                     [--fail-on {critical,high,medium,low,info,review,none}]
                     [--format {text,json,markdown}] [--quiet]

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --config CONFIG       Explicit local trustweave.toml path.
  --no-config-discovery
                        Require --config instead of discovering trustweave.toml from the current
                        directory.
  --output-dir OUTPUT_DIR
                        Override the configured local artifact directory.
  --source-revision SOURCE_REVISION
                        Source revision recorded in the local evidence attestation.
  --coverage            Include policy rule coverage diagnostics.
  --exit-on-review      Return status 1 when a selected review stage reports any finding.
  --fail-on {critical,high,medium,low,info,review,none}
                        Return status 1 at the selected severity, or for any finding with review.
  --format {text,json,markdown}
                        Render the final local CI summary as text, JSON, or Markdown.
  --quiet               Suppress the final CI summary message.
